taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-03, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

The layer resistivities are $\rho_1 = 177.8$, $\rho_2 = 265.8$, $\rho_3 = 1064.5$, and $\rho_4 = 2584.7$. 

For a 4-layer model, we evaluate two groups of three consecutive layers:
1.  **Layers 1-2-3**: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$ ($177.8 < 265.8 < 1064.5$). This corresponds to the letter **A**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4**: $\rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$ ($265.8 < 1064.5 < 2584.7$). This corresponds to the letter **A**.

The resulting sequence of letters is AA. Since all letters are the same, the curve can be simplified to the single letter **A**. The provided label "HA" is incorrect because the first group (1-2-3) does not follow the H pattern ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$).

{"label_correct": false, "curve_type": "A"}
